code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests, re
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrow

P="/agent/jobs/21a3a723-58c5-4fca-8ed8-e8c861fa5e39/provenance/"

# consensus table across the three methods actually run
cons=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(method="UniProt feature table (database)", ftm3_TM=1, ftm3_span="38-60", ftm3_orientation="not stated",
      longmember_TM="5 (6 for Q9P3E6)", reachable="yes"),
 dict(method="Kyte-Doolittle w=19, threshold 1.6", ftm3_TM=1, ftm3_span="~36-54 (peak 45, max 1.61)",
      ftm3_orientation="n/a", longmember_TM="4 blocks", reachable="yes"),
 dict(method="dG predictor (Hessa in vivo scale)", ftm3_TM=1, ftm3_span="38-59 (dG -0.63 kcal/mol)",
      ftm3_orientation="n/a", longmember_TM="5", reachable="yes"),
 dict(method="Phobius HMM (Kall et al. 2004)", ftm3_TM=1, ftm3_span="38-59",
      ftm3_orientation="i38-59o  (N-in / C-out), no signal peptide", longmember_TM="7", reachable="yes"),
 dict(method="TOPCONS2", ftm3_TM=None, ftm3_span="not obtained", ftm3_orientation="not obtained",
      longmember_TM="not obtained", reachable="NO: submission endpoint returned HTTP 500"),
 dict(method="CCTOP", ftm3_TM=None, ftm3_span="not obtained", ftm3_orientation="not obtained",
      longmember_TM="not obtained", reachable="NO: HTTP 404"),
 dict(method="DeepTMHMM (BioLib)", ftm3_TM=None, ftm3_span="not obtained", ftm3_orientation="not obtained",
      longmember_TM="not obtained", reachable="NO: HTTP 404"),
 dict(method="AlphaFold DB v6 model", ftm3_TM=None, ftm3_span="uninformative", ftm3_orientation="uninformative",
      longmember_TM="uninformative", reachable="yes, but mean pLDDT 51.7, 0% above 70"),
])
cons.to_csv(P+"table5_method_consensus.csv",index=False)
print(cons.to_string(index=False))

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,6.4))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1],width_ratios=[1,1.35],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.18)

def draw_topo(ax,topo,n,title,sub):
    # topo like 'i38-59o' or 'o95-116i128-145o...'
    toks=re.findall(r"([io])(\d+)-(\d+)",topo)
    last=topo[-1]
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0,0.30),n,0.40,facecolor="#e8edf2",edgecolor="#8a97a3",lw=1))
    ax.text(-0.012*n,0.50,"membrane",ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8,color="#58666f")
    ax.axhline(0.30,color="#8a97a3",lw=0.8); ax.axhline(0.70,color="#8a97a3",lw=0.8)
    ax.text(n*0.5,0.80,"non-cytoplasmic (lumenal)",ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#2c5f8a")
    ax.text(n*0.5,0.12,"cytoplasmic",ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#8a5a2c")
    prev=0
    for k,(side,s,e) in enumerate(toks):
        s,e=int(s),int(e)
        # loop before helix
        y=0.18 if side=="i" else 0.84
        ax.plot([prev,s],[y,y],color=("#c08040" if side=="i" else "#4a86b8"),lw=2.2,solid_capstyle="round")
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((s,0.22),e-s+1,0.56,facecolor="#e07b39",edgecolor="k",lw=0.8))
        ax.text((s+e)/2,0.50,str(k+1),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,color="white",weight="bold")
        prev=e
    y=0.18 if last=="i" else 0.84
    ax.plot([prev,n],[y,y],color=("#c08040" if last=="i" else "#4a86b8"),lw=2.2,solid_capstyle="round")
    ax.plot(0,0.18 if toks[0][0]=="i" else 0.84,marker="o",ms=7,color="#2e7d32")
    ax.text(0,(0.06 if toks[0][0]=="i" else 0.95),"N",ha="center",fontsize=9,weight="bold",color="#2e7d32")
    ax.plot(n,y,marker="s",ms=7,color="#8e24aa")
    ax.text(n,(0.06 if last=="i" else 0.95),"C",ha="center",fontsize=9,weight="bold",color="#8e24aa")
    ax.set_xlim(-0.06*n,1.05*n); ax.set_ylim(0,1.05); ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.set_xlabel("residue",fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title(title+"\n"+sub,fontsize=9.5)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0]); draw_topo(ax,"i38-59o",146,"ftm3 / P0CU06 (146 aa)","Phobius: 1 TM, 0 SP, topology i38-59o")
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0]); draw_topo(ax,"o95-116i128-145o177-193i200-220o232-250i271-288o300-322i",344,
    "SPAC750.05c / Q9P3E6 (344 aa)","Phobius: 7 TM, 0 SP; dG predictor: 5 TM; UniProt: 6")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[:,1]); ax.axis("off")
tab=cons[["method","ftm3_TM","ftm3_span","reachable"]].copy()
tab.columns=["method","ftm3\nTM","ftm3 TM span / note","reachable from this run"]
tab["ftm3\nTM"]=tab["ftm3\nTM"].map(lambda v:"-" if pd.isna(v) else str(int(v)))
t=ax.table(cellText=tab.values,colLabels=tab.columns,loc="center",cellLoc="left",colWidths=[0.30,0.07,0.36,0.33])
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(7.4); t.scale(1,1.55)
for (r,c),cell in t.get_celld().items():
    cell.set_linewidth(0.4)
    if r==0: cell.set_facecolor("#dfe6ed"); cell.set_text_props(weight="bold")
    elif r<=4: cell.set_facecolor("#eef6ee")
    else: cell.set_facecolor("#f7f7f7")
ax.set_title("Methods actually run, and methods that could not be reached",fontsize=10,pad=16)

fig.suptitle("ftm3 is a type II single-pass membrane protein: one helix at 38-59, N-terminus cytoplasmic, 85-residue C-terminal tail lumenal\n"
             "Four methods agree on one helix; the 344 aa PF09437 member is polytopic with the opposite N-terminal orientation",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.90])
plt.show()
